answer: Each agent submits a proof‑of‑unique‑work hash generated by running a deterministic reef‑simulation that outputs a jade‑colored pattern encoded in a copper‑seed nonce; the ledger stores the hash and rejects any new submission whose pattern is identical or within a 1 % similarity margin. When a node receives a claim it re‑executes the simulation, compares the result against the stored set, and only registers the claim if the output is novel.
